hotels.title: Bestselling Rottnest Island Beachside Eco-Glamping with Daily Breakfast & A$50 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Indulge your senses and inner nature enthusiast with a beachside glamping stay at the serene Discovery Resorts - Rottnest Island. Nestled by the fine sands of the iconic Pinky Beach, just off the coast of Perth, a natural, eco-friendly oasis awaits. Sleep (almost) under the stars in a safari-style glamping tent and take the opportunity to disconnect from the world as you discover the 63 white-sand beaches, 20 crystal-clear bays and unique native wildlife of Rottnest Island. This tranquil beachfront haven - home to 83 safari-style eco-tents - invites you to discover the island’s simple pleasures as you reconnect with nature. Pristine sand, clear waters, coral reefs, passing dolphin pods, adorable quokkas and alfresco dining amid native bushland are the attractions that make up this 20-million-dollar glamping resort. Roam through nature, discover rich cultural heritage, explore nearby beaches and swim and snorkel in crystal-clear waters. Spend your days beach-hopping, taking snaps with the world’s happiest animals, dining on the locally inspired fare at Pinky's Rottnest Island and sampling a terrific selection of West Australian wines from the pool bar, before returning to your private sanctuary among enormous native trees.
